releasePlan.notes: Flag gates EnrichCheckout: control returns 3-item recommendations at 220-320ms; v1 returns 5-item recommendations (adds loyalty-points, price-match) at 200-400ms. Monitor http-latency-checkout (OTel auto-emitted, fires on both arms) as the primary guardrail for latency regression at p95/p99. Randomization unit is request (per-request latency change, no stickiness requirement; multi-context already carries a unique request-kind key). No prerequisite: this flag gates the old-checkout arm which is the active dominant path (new-checkout-flow = false for all production traffic).

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
